primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

adjacentContextChecks.text: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
adjacentContextChecks.nextText: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

adjacentContextChecks.previousText: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
adjacentContextChecks.text: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
adjacentContextChecks.nextText: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
